caller_is_legitimate_builder_admin.meaning: the caller of sweep() is the legitimate builderAdmin

all_tokens_drained.meaning: all tokens held by BuilderWallet are drained via sweep()

assumptions: sweep() is the function through which wallet tokens can be transferred out of BuilderWallet.
The legitimate builderAdmin is distinct from the arbitrary attacker caller.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether init() had already been called or whether builderAdmin was previously set before the attacker's call, so the pre-state of builderAdmin is not fixed.
Report does not specify token amounts or types held by BuilderWallet, so the drained quantity is only characterized as 'all tokens'.
Report does not state whether sweep() has its own access control restricting it to builderAdmin.
Report does not establish that the attacker's sweep() call actually succeeded in a real transaction.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the drain_all_tokens impact; admin_takeover and loss_of_funds are handled in separate passes.
The drained amount is represented as the Boolean 'all tokens drained' because the report gives no numeric token quantities.
The legitimate builderAdmin identity is symbolic; no concrete address is required.
